notes: EXCLUDED FROM THE TRAINING SET. The measured analyte is MILRINONE (MRN), a small-molecule phosphodiesterase-3 inhibitor loaded into human serum albumin nanoparticles that carry the AT1 peptide as a surface targeting ligand. The paper's own control makes this unambiguous: free 'MRN Lactate' has a half-life of 64.7 min against the nanoparticle's 101.3 min, a 1.6-fold formulation effect on the same drug. PEPlife2 files the 101.3 min value against the sequence GGGGDRVYIHPF - a GGGG linker plus angiotensin II - whose own concentration is never measured. PEPlife2 ID 4910 dropped via CURATED_NOT_A_HALF_LIFE.
